title: The AD CS autoenrollment sc_partial row tests partial knowledge, and a test asserts the scenario answer-not-in-pack message
goal: The sc_partial row on AD CS certificate autoenrollment templates in kb/public/_retrieval/bench_scenarios.csv and bench_pool.csv is replaced by a question whose present part a kb line answers (its regex today matches the Intune PKCS connector template line, and the kb has no autoenrollment fact, so the row tests absent knowledge); and _tools/test_bench.py asserts scenario_problems' message for a row whose answer regex matches no line of its pack. Found by the SP-j2jn5ue4 review.
